drop.title: Files
drop.openTitleLocked: Open it: this answers to your account, not a stranger's

notices.privateLine1: This drop is private: its URL opens for your account and anyone you've shared it with, and answers 404 to anyone else, link or no link.
notices.privateLine2Owner: To let anyone with the link open it, switch it to unlisted from Metadata; public also lists it.
notices.privateLine2Other: Only someone who can edit it can open it up to others.
notices.sharedLine1: This drop lives in someone else's drive, and you're seeing it because it was shared with you as an {access}.
notices.sharedLine2Editor: You can change its contents, but not delete it.
notices.sharedLine2Viewer: You can only open and download it.
notices.entrypointMissing: This drop opens {entrypoint}, and no file with that name exists: its URL answers 404. Upload that page, or change the entrypoint from Metadata to whichever file you want served.

files.generatedTitle: kept up to date by the API
files.deleteDescription: "{name}" will be removed from this drop. This cannot be undone.

versions.subtitle: Version history
versions.restoreDescription: The drop's URL will start serving version {seq} again. Nothing is deleted: the current version stays in the history.

deleteDrop.title: Delete this drop?
deleteDrop.description: The drop and all its files will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

editMeta.title: Drop metadata
editMeta.description: Saved to the .drop file alongside the drop's files.

upload.title: Upload files
upload.description: A file with the same name replaces the one already in the drop.
